description: Eighteen scenarios are run through the QA WF2 clone and checked by hard deterministic assertions before any model judgment is consulted.
why_it_exists: Semantic judgment by a model cannot be the only gate on a legal pipeline. The deterministic layer encodes the behaviours that had already regressed once each: matter isolation, continuation fact loading, and question deduplication.

expect.A10_D10_no_duplicates: case-insensitive trimmed questions are all unique

assertions: D8: a NEW_MATTER must never inherit facts from an existing matter - known_facts must be empty.
D9: a CONTINUE_MATTER must load the existing matter's facts - known_facts must be non-empty.
D10: the question list must contain no case-insensitive trimmed duplicates.
Every assertion carries a severity, and the deterministic layer runs before the semantic judge so a hard failure is never argued away by a model.
Assertions are skipped rather than failed when the scenario declares no expectation for that field, so an under-specified scenario cannot produce a false pass on a field it never claimed.
The suite writes nothing to production - the WF2 under test is the QA clone whose Sheets writes are all replaced by pass-through no-ops.
target_unresolved_reason: Administrative / QA-infrastructure workflow. No WF1-WF5/WF9 Code node implements it.
